payload.reason: The evidence provides specific deep learning methods used for hate speech detection, including FastText, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), and Long Short-Term Memory Networks (LSTMs).

claims.text: The deep learning methods investigated for hate speech detection include FastText, Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), and Long Short-Term Memory Networks (LSTMs).
Deep Neural Networks (DNNs) were also utilized in the experiments for hate speech detection.
The combination of LSTM with Random Embedding and Gradient Boosted Decision Trees (GBDT) was identified as the best performing method.
